title: Prepare and deliver private job application packets
summary: Prepare private briefs and Jackson-only resumes for eligible Cast jobs or one supplied job URL. Freeze editions and send retained attachment bytes through authorized daily or ad hoc runs.
use_when: The user wants to prepare or preview eligible Cast opportunities with a concise brief and a constrained resume.
The user wants an explicitly authorized send or another edition composed from retained materials.
The user wants to change job eligibility or export a retained artifact to an explicit destination.
The user has authorized daily email and wants one invocation to prepare, freeze and send the current local-date edition.
The user explicitly wants one supplied public job URL prepared and emailed to the fixed personal recipient.
do_not_use_when: The request is job discovery, CRM editing, employer outreach or application submission.
The caller expects stored delivery settings or installation alone to enable a schedule, or wants a change to fixed resume content.
outcome: Stored accepted brief, Jackson bullets, source references and rendered resume. Preview freezes one through three ready packets. An authorized send separately records provider acceptance.

interfaces.label: Restart incomplete preparation without prior model context
Prepare, freeze and send the authorized daily edition
Prepare, freeze and send one URL-selected packet
Freeze and preview a dated edition
Preview retained packets as an retained-material edition
Preview an retained-material edition with reviewed paragraph overrides
Print the selected release daily failure policy without activation

effects: Initialization imports the original template and configuration into the canonical SQLite library.
Preparation captures Cast posting and CRM career inputs, runs constrained Nucleus stages and retains accepted content and rendered bytes as artifacts referencing the preparation run.
Ordinary preview retrieves the posting again under the source cache policy. It freezes subject, body and ordered artifact references, and sets selected jobs ineligible in the same transaction.
Retained-material preview creates the same edition records without changing eligibility or calling Cast, CRM, employer sources, Nucleus or the renderer.

Send pipes body and attachment bytes to Email. It records uncertainty before transport and acceptance afterward. Eligibility changes separately through the CLI. Export creates a new caller-selected file.

run-daily captures one configured local date and holds mutation admission across preparation, ordinary preview and send. An existing edition goes directly to send; no ready packets creates no edition or email.

run-ad-hoc asks Cast to resolve or collect one URL, explicitly enables that normal Platter job, then uses the existing preparation, freshness, ordinary eligibility-spending edition freeze and send operations. It creates no separate packet, edition or workflow type.

Ashby retrieval writes and reuses private ashby-cache/BOARD.json files under the canonical runtime root. Each file contains the complete response and its download time; it is disposable and outside SQLite.

A posting retrieval failure retains or updates the job as ineligible. Initial retrieval failures create no preparation run. Freshness failures retain prepared runs as deferred and preserve accepted artifacts.
authority: Platter owns captured inputs, content validation, explicit job eligibility, edition identity and delivery state. Nucleus owns execution and tool-call history.
Writers author only plain Jackson bullets; all other original resume source bytes remain fixed. The independent reviewer submits only free-text Markdown and cannot accept a resume.

Each send requires applicable user authority. Explicit authorization to enable recurring daily email supplies standing authority for ordinary daily briefs and resume attachments to the fixed personal recipient. Invoking run-ad-hoc is one explicit send instruction for its selected URL and occurrence. Preparation, preview, catalog presence and model output grant no send authority.
success: Preparation succeeds when accepted brief/resume artifacts and a validated one-page PDF are retained. New runs also require a validated draft and completed Markdown review before revision.
Preview freezes exact message and ordered immutable artifacts without sending.
A recognized Accepted ID proves submission acceptance, not final inbox delivery. Job eligibility is an explicit field, never inferred from edition history.

run-daily returns the retained accepted edition, or a no-edition result when no packets are ready. Its output selects edition date, delivery status and packet count; it does not print message or attachment contents.
run-ad-hoc returns the same compact accepted-edition result for one packet, or reports that no ready packet was produced without creating or sending an edition.
failure_and_recovery: A consistent schema-three SQLite backup contains the complete packet history. Disposable Ashby board caches are excluded and can be downloaded again. Schema-one and schema-two state require maintained migration.
Exact pending Nucleus requests are retained. Successful submissions resolve to immutable run content; Platter stores no separate tool-receipt ledger.

Accepted content survives later execution failure. Uncertain sends remain held and accepted editions are not resent. There is no automatic new model attempt, direct Codex fallback or ambiguous-send reconciliation.

run-daily uses an existing edition before preparing any new work. Frozen editions send exact retained bytes; sent editions return their result; uncertain editions fail without resending. It has no backfill or replacement-send loop. Posting retrieval failures are skipped before freeze; other preparation/export failures preserve retained progress and stop before send.

An explicitly authorized prepare JOB_ID --fresh requires an eligible incomplete latest run without an accepted resume and terminal or absent prior model jobs. It captures source inputs again and creates new run and model-job IDs without copying prior outputs, requests, transcripts or error feedback. Older runs remain retained.

Renderer executable or execution failure requests cancellation of the exact model job and stops preparation, including the daily run. It is not model content feedback. Repair the environment before an explicit fresh preparation; content and layout rejection still allows revision in the current job.

prepare-daily and run-daily mark jobs ineligible when posting retrieval fails, including HTTP errors, timeouts and unsupported or incomplete text, then continue with other candidates. If final freshness excludes the entire ready pool, run-daily prepares other candidates before previewing again. Declined opportunities and an exhausted pool remain expected outcomes. Other preparation failures stop the run. Single-job preparation reports retrieval failure without selecting another job. The eligibility command explicitly enables an excluded job again. Clockwork halts remain intact until explicit continuation.

run-ad-hoc reuses an existing frozen or accepted occurrence before Cast or preparation work. Exact retries send frozen bytes or return retained acceptance. An uncertain occurrence remains held. Reusing its ID for another URL or a multi-packet retained-material edition is refused.

Review and revision reuse their exact retained requests and completed prior results. A failed stage without a result stops preparation. --fresh checks every retained stage job and creates an entirely new preparation when authorized.
privacy: Private state includes career history, preferences, contact details, source text and tailored resumes. Keep it outside the repository and exclude it from commits.
Nucleus and its model receive captured career material. Only an explicitly authorized send discloses the brief and resume to the fixed personal recipient via Email, Resend and Gmail.
does_not_authorize: Installing or enabling any scheduled activation.
Sending when the user requested only preparation or preview.
Changing fixed resume content, modifying CRM or Cast outside run-ad-hoc's exact URL collection, applying to a job or contacting an employer.

consumers.statement: The current user and an explicitly authorized local caller can operate the Platter CLI.

preconditions.statement: Preparation requires initialized schema-three state, the supported resume template, readable Cast and CRM interfaces, and full posting text from a supported adapter. It also requires strict authenticated Nucleus readiness and supported rendering tools. Sending requires authorization and Email with --payload-stdin.
Retained-material preview needs completed artifacts only. It makes no source, model or rendering calls.

inputs.statement: Fresh canonical state is ~/.local/share/platter; a sole ~/.local/share/job-packets predecessor stays in place. Both roots are ambiguous and refused; --state-dir must match the canonical root. Original resume and override paths are import inputs, not continuing content dependencies.

Preparation selects a Cast job, eligible daily pool, or one exact public URL through run-ad-hoc. Optional --stop-after-seconds applies to prepare, prepare-daily and run-ad-hoc. Default count is three; stored 09:00 fields create no schedule. The two run commands capture the current date once in the configured time zone before new preparation.

--ad-hoc RUN_ID selects another retained-material edition identity, not a test type. It accepts up to three --packet selections, optional imported --brief-overrides and an invocation-local absolute --email-executable on send. RUN_ID is 1 through 80 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

run-ad-hoc accepts one public JOB_URL and a required --id occurrence of 1 through 80 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. It uses the same ad-hoc occurrence namespace as retained-material selection. The ID binds one URL and one packet.

outputs.statement: SQLite retains jobs with eligible fields, preparation runs with captured inputs and compact execution correlation, immutable brief/resume/source/PDF artifacts, exact editions, ordered artifact references, receipts, configuration and maintenance holds. Artifacts reference their producing run; imported templates have no run.

CLI attachment references are artifact IDs. Export explicitly writes a new private file at the chosen destination. Rendering uses disposable files and redirected caches beneath the runtime root, removed after use; it is not memory-only rendering.

run-daily and run-ad-hoc return a compact edition date, status and selected packet count, or a no-edition result. They write no message or PDF bytes to stdout. Status and doctor identify scheduling as external without checking the Clockwork binding.

Ashby board caches are private ashby-cache/BOARD.json files under the runtime root, containing response and retrieved_at. Successful downloads with a valid jobs array replace the file atomically. Captured packets retain their own selected posting bytes and the original board download time.

data_semantics.statement: New preparations run draft, independent Markdown review and revision as sequential Nucleus jobs. The revision copies the exact retained writer request and adds only the draft with evidence references and raw review text. Writer inputs, policy, model settings, tools and rendering checks otherwise remain identical. The reviewer sees the draft, posting, captured career library and policy without writer history, rationale or brief. Markdown headings are suggested; Platter does not parse findings or verdicts and requires no finding responses from the writer. Review must complete before revision; final artifact checks determine acceptance.

New briefs contain at most 90 words across sections. Why it works gives one or two direct, confident, evidence-grounded sentences of at most 45 words. Role states stack, responsibilities and process expectations in one or two short lines of at most 30 words. Optional Culture states working norms in one or two short lines of at most 25 words. Role and Culture make no comparison with the user's experience. Displayed briefs omit caveats, downsides and hedging; pursuit criteria remain private. Career references identify the captured entries used by each stage. The resume model cannot author fixed sections, dates, identity, employers, projects, skills or layout.

Eligibility determines whether Platter may consider a job. Ordinary preview sets selected jobs ineligible. Posting retrieval failures also set jobs ineligible; daily work continues with other candidates. Explicit eligibility changes can enable excluded jobs again. run-ad-hoc explicitly enables its selected normal job, then its ordinary one-packet freeze sets that job ineligible. Retained-material preview and send leave eligibility unchanged. Eligibility changes preserve delivery records. All editions share one representation and ordinary subject format. Imported frozen subjects remain unchanged.

identity_and_units.statement: Canonical supported ATS identities or normalized URLs identify opportunities. A run ID identifies one preparation; artifacts reference that run. Three packets is a ceiling, not a quota. Perfect repost deduplication is not promised.

Ordinary edition identity is its day; --ad-hoc and run-ad-hoc retain a caller-supplied occurrence ID in the same namespace. Frozen date, selection, message, ordered attachment names/bytes and idempotency key are immutable. A deliberately changed payload requires a new identity.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: All stages use the same stored posting and captured CRM library. Culture appears only when the posting or captured material supports it. Otherwise it is omitted without extra research or an uncertainty note. Separate CRM list and read calls do not share a transaction. Capture checks entry timestamps and rejects incomplete lists. Preparation requires full posting text beyond Cast's excerpt. A new preview retrieves the posting under the source cache policy and excludes changed or unavailable inputs from eligibility while retaining their prepared artifacts. Reopening a frozen edition returns stored contents.
Posting fetches use the documented ATS and JobPosting JSON-LD adapters. Forms and authenticated pages are outside these fetch interfaces.
Ad hoc preview reads existing accepted artifacts, consuming no Cast API budget and making no source-fetch, discovery-export, profile, model or rendering calls.

A new run-ad-hoc occurrence uses Cast's exact job-URL operation, normal Cast export and the same posting, CRM, model, rendering and pre-freeze freshness reads as daily work. An existing occurrence bypasses those reads and follows its retained send state.

Preparation, including --fresh, and preview reuse an Ashby board downloaded less than 14 days ago if it contains the selected posting. Missing, invalid, expired or future-dated caches and a posting absent from the cache trigger one download. Cached timestamps remain the original download time. Changes and closures can remain undetected until the next download. A failed refresh leaves the old file intact but fails retrieval; expired data is not a fallback. Remove a board cache file to force its next download.

access.statement: Current-user commands use a private canonical SQLite database. Models access only captured inputs through constrained requester tools. Email receives attachment bytes through stdin and retains credential and fixed-recipient authority.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Successful stage outputs are immutable by producing run and kind. Repeated successful calls return the same content; conflicts are refused. Platter stores exact Nucleus requests before submission. Nucleus owns execution history.

Ordinary edition creation and eligibility changes commit together. Frozen message/attachments remain immutable. Sending state commits before Email runs, recognized acceptance commits afterward, and uncertain attempts remain held. Neither test types nor derived sent flags govern eligibility.

One CLI admission lock spans run-daily preparation, preview and send. An existing edition bypasses preparation and follows the retained send rules. Empty days create no edition or email and may be tried by a later invocation. The captured date stays fixed across midnight; missed dates are not backfilled.

The same CLI admission lock spans run-ad-hoc URL selection, preparation, freshness, freeze and send. An existing occurrence bypasses URL collection and preparation, retains its original date across retries, and follows the same frozen, accepted and uncertain send rules. No separate durable workflow state is created.

An explicitly authorized prepare JOB_ID --fresh requires an eligible incomplete latest run without an accepted resume and terminal or absent prior model jobs. It captures source inputs again and creates new run and model-job IDs without copying prior outputs, requests, transcripts or error feedback. Older runs remain retained.

For a new URL selection, Cast permits targeted observation from disabled or automatically excluded sources, retains only the selected job, and preserves source enrollment and board-scan progress. Platter continues with that normal job through export and preparation.

operational_limits.statement: No candidate or token budget caps daily preparation. Model gpt-5.6-sol with max effort runs brief then resume. Individual execution, network and rendering safety timeouts remain. Full posting adapters and one-page original-template rendering impose explicit input limits; runtime allowance and provider limits still apply.
No preparation-latency, completion-time, delivery-time or throughput guarantee exists. Activation is a separately authorized Clockwork operation; stored 09:00 fields do not control it.

PDF inspection keeps the same Python user-package lookup as doctor and disables bytecode writes. Tectonic uses a temporary home. Renderer executable or execution failures stop daily preparation and request exact-job cancellation; content and layout errors remain model revision feedback.

Ashby board downloads and cache files have no byte cap. The HTTP timeout remains 30 seconds. Other posting responses retain the 4,000,000-byte cap; each selected posting retains the 1,000,000-byte input limit.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Preparation contract 8 excludes jobs after posting retrieval failure and continues with other daily candidates. The independent resume review workflow, private schema 3, exact retained requests, packet artifacts and frozen deliveries remain unchanged. Installation contract 5, Cast collection contract 5 and Clockwork schedule contract 3 remain required.
No arbitrary incompatible rollback, future template replacement, model support interval or deprecation window is promised.

reliances.statement: Retained job evidence and stable discovery IDs come from Cast supported exports.
URL-selected runs rely on Cast to resolve or collect one supplied public posting into its normal job records.
Career entries come from CRM supported profile list and read operations.
Constrained execution, authentication and durable requester-tool transport rely on Nucleus.
Explicit fixed-recipient submission with local attachments relies on Email contract 4.
Full posting retrieval depends on employer HTTPS sources and their supported ATS or JobPosting representations.
PDF generation depends on locally available LaTeX, fonts and PDF inspection executables.

The product-owned schema-two definition declares halt-until-approved. Clockwork owns activation, durable failure admission, incident email and explicit continuation; Platter owns expected readiness outcomes, date selection and preserved preparation/delivery recovery.
